name: israel-open-data-api
title: Israel Open Data (data.gov.il) - clean JSON, pay per record
description: Search and fetch Israeli government open datasets (companies registrar, NGO registry, public tenders, municipalities and more) from data.gov.il as clean, English-keyed, typed, paginated JSON. Pay-per-event: 'dataset-search' per search, 'record' per returned record.

ppeEvents._comment: Documentation only. Pay-per-event prices are configured in Apify Console -> Actor -> Monetization. Event names here must match Actor.charge() calls in src/main.ts.

dataset-search.title: Dataset search
dataset-search.description: One search of the data.gov.il catalogue (mode=search_datasets). Charged once per run, regardless of the number of datasets returned.

record.title: Record returned
record.description: One clean, normalized record pushed to the dataset (mode=fetch_records). Charged per record actually returned; failed runs charge nothing extra.
